Project: Yum Plushies Waitlist Website

## Project Overview
A product launch waitlist website for Yum Plushies, a stuffed animal company featuring food-themed plushies. The website captures email addresses and optional plushie preferences.

## Requirements
- Email capture form (required field)
- Optional plushie selection dropdown (4 products: Tofu Cube, Spicy Tofu, Lychee, Rambutan)
- Modern, responsive design with cute, friendly aesthetic
- Mobile-friendly layout
- Form submission handling with success message
- Uses provided logo and product images

## Tech Stack
- HTML5
- CSS3 (custom styling with cute color palette)
- Vanilla JavaScript for form handling
- Static website (no backend required initially)

## Design Guidelines
- Color palette: warm, inviting colors (pink, cream, green accents)
- Fonts: Playful but readable (Fredoka, Quicksand)
- Layout: Clean, centered, card-based design
- Tagline: "Foods are Friends"
